added_comments.text: # drop fractional seconds (any number of digits; the ledger is whole seconds)
# Acme: ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. +02:00

rationale: The agent kept the _KNOWN_FORMATS try-each-strptime workaround and appended three more %z format strings to it, plus generalized the fractional-seconds stripper; the underlying defect (ad hoc string mangling instead of real ISO 8601 parsing) remains. The Globex date-only branch was not touched, so the protected end-of-day behavior is preserved.
